reviews.title: Disappointing Customer Experience: No Cancellation Option and Lack of Support
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience ordering through Foodpanda.

What made this experience frustrating was the lack of a clear option to cancel an order when the situation required it. There was also no accessible way to directly communicate my concern or request immediate assistance.

What concerns me most is that the current process seems to leave both customers and delivery riders without proper protection when problems arise. Customers should not be left helpless, and riders should not have to bear the consequences of issues beyond their control.

Foodpanda needs to improve its cancellation process, customer support accessibility, and accountability. A reliable delivery platform should protect both its customers and delivery partners, not leave them struggling to resolve problems on their own.

I hope Foodpanda takes this feedback seriously and makes meaningful improvements.

A refund does not make up for four hours wasted or resolve the frustration caused by poor communication and unhelpful support. I am extremely disappointed with how this was handled and will consider taking the matter to the DTI.

Foodpanda seriously needs to improve its order management and customer service. Customers deserve better than scripted replies and unresolved complaints.

1. Unavailable items: Some items I ordered were apparently unavailable, but they were still shown as available when I placed the order. Why aren't unavailable items updated before customers place an order?

2. Limited replacement choices: When an item was unavailable, I only had about 5 minutes to choose between a refund or replacement. However, the replacement options showed only around 9 items instead of the full range available in the store, so l couldn't find suitable replacements.

3. Unable to cancel: After choosing a refund for the unavailable items, I wanted to cancel the entire order and place a new one so everything could be delivered together. However, customer service told me that if I cancelled, I would not receive a refund, meaning I would lose around RM50-80.

Overall, the system feels poorly designed and managed.
Customers should not be allowed to order items that are already unavailable, replacement options should include the actual available products in the store, and customers should have a reasonable way to cancel an order when the main items they wanted are unavailable.

I hope Foodpanda improves this process because this experience makes me hesitant to use this grocery service again or even recommend to people.

Absolutely terrible customer experience. I wish I could leave zero stars.

This was one of the most frustrating experiences I’ve had with a food delivery platform. The issue itself was bad enough, but what made it significantly worse was the complete lack of meaningful customer support.

Instead of actually resolving the problem, I was met with generic responses, repetitive explanations, and what felt like an endless loop of automated or scripted support. There was no real ownership of the issue and no indication that anyone genuinely cared about finding a solution.

When you pay for a delivery service, you expect the platform to take responsibility when something goes wrong. Here, I was left feeling completely ignored and powerless as a customer.

Foodpanda seriously needs to rethink its approach to customer service. A company can make mistakes, but refusing to properly address those mistakes is what turns a bad order into an absolutely terrible customer experience.

After this experience, I have very little confidence in using Foodpanda again. Extremely disappointing.

reviews.title: From great to disappointing
reviews.text:
Foodpanda Malaysia has gone from being one of my favorite delivery apps to one of the most disappointing subscription services I have ever paid for. As a Panda Pro member, I genuinely feel cheated by the continuous reduction of benefits. Every few months, another perk disappears. First, vouchers became less generous. Then the number of vouchers kept getting reduced. Now some vouchers can only be used a handful of times each month. What exactly am I paying for?

The rewards points system was also removed, which means loyal customers can no longer earn and redeem points for discounts. Instead of rewarding long-term users, Foodpanda seems determined to take away every feature that once made the platform worthwhile.

The most frustrating part is that Panda Pro no longer feels like a premium membership. The gap between being a paying subscriber and a regular user has become so small that I am seriously questioning why I continue to subscribe. It feels like Foodpanda’s strategy is simple: reduce benefits, increase costs, and hope customers won’t notice. Unfortunately, we do notice.

After years of using Foodpanda, this is the worst customer experience I have seen from the platform. Unless the company starts listening to its customers and restoring real value, I will have a hard time recommending this service to anyone.

Whenever there is an issue, it feels like you're talking to automated responses rather than getting actual help.

I've experienced missing items and incorrect orders multiple times, and getting a refund takes far longer than it should. The app also tends to charge various fees that make the final price much higher than expected. What's worse is that when problems occur, the responsibility often gets passed between the restaurant, rider, and Foodpanda support without any clear resolution.

For a service that charges delivery and service fees, customers deserve better reliability and support. Until Foodpanda improves its customer service and order accuracy, I cannot recommend this app.

reviews.title: Poor Delivery Riders
reviews.text:
I’ve been really disappointed with Foodpanda lately. The delivery delays and inconsistent service aren’t just random issues—they’re coming from a much bigger problem. I actually spoke with one of the riders, and it turns out a lot of them aren’t being paid fairly for the amount of work they do. They’re forced to complete extremely hard “quests” or a high number of deliveries just to earn bonuses that used to be easier to achieve.

It’s frustrating as a customer when orders arrive late or incomplete, but it’s even more frustrating to learn that the riders are struggling because the system doesn’t support them. Many of them are out on the road for hours, rain or shine, but the pay doesn’t match the effort they’re giving.

Foodpanda seriously needs to fix its payment system, improve support for riders, and stop making it harder for them to earn a decent income. The service quality won’t improve until the people doing the actual work are treated better.
